title: Build the student view from an allowlist
statement: Build what a student sees from an allowlist of the fields meant for students, and test that view for answer leaks.
example: An independent read held back copying an AP course's first unit until six repairs were made, this allowlist among them.
detail: An independent read of an AP course's first unit blocked copying it forward on six repairs, one of them a student-only source view holding the student material and approved citation details, with the answer-bearing fields left out (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0167-portable-workspace-checkpoint-apush-g5.qmd`). A later commit closed all six with an explicit student-source allowlist, and the unit's validator passed with zero errors and zero warnings (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0170-apush-deliverable-shape-user-pause-checkpoint.qmd`). Mutation tests for student-answer leakage were still listed as work to do at that pause (the same file).
against: At that pause the leak tests were not yet written, and a later record of 13/13 projection tests passing doesn't say whether they cover leaks (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0171-apush-full-course-local-authoring-review-hub-archive.qmd`).

evidence.quote: It still issued **BLOCKED FOR REPLICATION** on six repair buckets:
Define a student-only source projection containing `student_material` plus approved citation metadata,
view(item) { return { kind: "choice", stem: item.stem, options: item.options }; },
The student view must never carry a key, feedback, evidence or a model answer.
every mechanic's shape, code checks and judge questions, that no student view carries a key, feedback, evidence or a model answer
Student source projection is allowlisted, not subtractive. It copies only source ID, kind, creator,
The student view is built from an explicit allowlist and omits keys, rubrics, diagnostics, correction routes, models, evaluation state, and internal evidence.
